project_title: Bhavita Textiles - Luxury Editorial Textile Lookbook & B2B Catalogue Redesign
design_archetype: Luxury Editorial Lookbook & Architectural Craft Magazine (Archetype 5: Luxury & Organic Craft)

theme_strategy.light_mode_description: Warm Ivory (#FBF9F5), Parchment (#EFECE6), Warm Linen (#F4F1EA), Charcoal (#1C1B18), Muted Earthy Accents. Soft, tactile, natural paper lookbook atmosphere.
theme_strategy.dark_mode_description: Evening Lookbook Atmosphere: Deep Charcoal (#181715), Warm Black (#0F0E0D), Soft Sand Cream (#F3EFEA), Muted Taupe (#9E968B). High-end evening showroom feel, never a harsh inverted blue/black.

typography.font_family_sans: Plus Jakarta Sans, Satoshi, Inter, sans-serif

hierarchy.hero_title: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-light tracking-tight leading-[1.05]
hierarchy.section_headline: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-normal tracking-tight leading-snug
hierarchy.story_number: text-xs sm:text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-taupe-600 dark:text-taupe-400
hierarchy.body_text: text-sm sm:text-base font-sans font-normal leading-relaxed text-charcoal-700/90 dark:text-cream-200/90
hierarchy.b2b_spec_label: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-charcoal-500 dark:text-cream-400

rules: NO INTER FOR HEADINGS. Use Cormorant Garamond or Playfair Display for all editorial headlines, section titles, story numbers, and hero text.
Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter) on headings above 32px.
Use wide uppercase letter spacing (tracking-[0.2em] or tracking-[0.25em]) for story indices, categories, badge tags, and overlines.
Max hero text ceiling is text-6xl (3.75rem/60px) on large screens. Do not use text-8xl or text-9xl.

layout_and_grids.lookbook_layout_mode: Asymmetric Editorial Lookbook with Story Spreads
spread_patterns: Spread Pattern 1 (Alternating 2-Column Hero Story): Left 7 cols full-height hero lifestyle image, Right 5 cols editorial story description + floating product buy button + subtle story index 'N° 01 / CRAFT & HERITAGE'.
Spread Pattern 2 (Single Featured Hero Banner): 12-column wide layout with negative space margin, large quiet image, caption offset on bottom left.
Spread Pattern 3 (3-Item Triptych Swatch Rhythm): Asymmetric grid [col-span-5, col-span-3, col-span-4] showcasing texture macro, ambient room shot, and drape flow.
Spread Pattern 4 (Editorial Catalog Grid): Zero boxy card borders. Pure image float with natural typography below or beside the image, fine 1px subtle divider lines, high contrast hover image zoom.

filter_bar_strategy.type: Collapsible Editorial Filter Bar with Refined Horizontal Triggers
filter_bar_strategy.description: Clean horizontal pills (Category, Weave, GSM/Weight, Color, Fiber, Application, MOQ Range) with subtle active count dot + 'Filter & Refine' trigger button that smoothly reveals a luxury expandable filter drawer or expandable row.
filter_bar_strategy.placement: Sticky below header with subtle backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-md bg-ivory/80 dark:bg-charcoal/80).

whole_website_propagation.header: Minimal luxury navigation bar. Brand wordmark 'BHAVITA TEXTILES' in refined serif, links ('LOOKBOOK', 'COLLECTIONS', 'SWATCHES', 'WHOLESALE B2B', 'OUR CRAFT'), search bar trigger, wishlist count, cart drawer trigger with subtle count badge. Semi-solid paper blur background.
whole_website_propagation.homepage: Editorial Showroom Experience: Hero Carousel/Video Spread, Curated Lookbook Story Spreads, Weaving Heritage Section, Tiered B2B Textile Inquiries Banner, Natural Materials Accordion, Artisan Press & Testimonials.
whole_website_propagation.catalogue_shop: Asymmetric Editorial Lookbook layout. Refined horizontal filter triggers + expandable luxury drawer. Sort dropdown ('Curated Editorial', 'Newest Looms', 'Weight: Light to Heavy', 'B2B Wholesale Popularity'). Seamless view mode switcher (Editorial Spread vs Compact Grid).
whole_website_propagation.product_detail_page: Split Editorial Layout: Sticky high-resolution gallery grid on left, elegant details & technical specs panel on right (Fiber Composition, GSM, Thread Count, Roll Width, MOQ, Sample Swatch request modal, Tiered B2B pricing table, Download Spec Sheet PDF button).
whole_website_propagation.cart: Slide-out luxury Cart Drawer + Full Cart Page with B2B MOQ progress bar ('Add 5 more meters for Tier 2 Wholesale Discount'), Swatch add-on trigger, estimated shipping date, inquiry note box.
whole_website_propagation.checkout: Clean 3-step luxury checkout flow with order summary accordion, GST/Business Tax ID input for B2B wholesale orders, Razorpay/Card/Bank Transfer mock options.
whole_website_propagation.wholesale_b2b: Dedicated B2B Portal page with sample kit request, trade application form, customizable volume MOQ inquiry form, downloadable digital lookbook PDF catalog.
whole_website_propagation.wishlist: Editorial moodboard view where saved textiles can be organized into 'Projects' or 'Client Rooms'.
whole_website_propagation.about_and_contact: Story of handloom looms, artisan cooperatives in Varanasi & Maheshwar, organic cotton/linen sourcing, interactive contact form with inquiry type selector.
whole_website_propagation.footer: Dark charcoal ground footer with large serif branding ('BHAVITA TEXTILES'), newsletter signup ('Join the Trade Journal'), sustainability certifications, copyright and navigation.

component_strategies.cards: Cardless / Paper-Floating aesthetic. NO visible boxy shadows or heavy border rectangles around product photos. Images should breathe with natural margins, subtle hover scale (scale-[1.02]), and elegant typographic caption block below.
component_strategies.buttons: Pill or sharp minimalist buttons. Primary CTA: Solid Charcoal with warm white text (or warm cream with dark charcoal text in dark mode). Secondary CTA: Delicate 1px border button with hover fill animation. 'Request Sample Swatch' button in muted terracotta.
component_strategies.modals_and_drawers: Shadcn Dialog and Sheet customized with paper background (#F8F5EF / #1F1E1A), clean border lines, and smooth spring transitions.
component_strategies.forms_and_inputs: Shadcn Input, Select, Checkbox heavily styled with paper background, 1px subtle taupe borders, crisp focus rings, and dark mode adaptations.
component_strategies.toasts: Sonner toast notifications with custom warm paper theme styling.

testing_attributes.rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST contain a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute a complete visual transformation from standard boxy ecommerce into an Asymmetric Editorial Lookbook.
Import Cormorant Garamond / Playfair Display font via Google Fonts in index.css / layout.tsx if not already imported.
Eliminate all heavy card outlines and shadows around product images. Product cards must be borderless paper-floating assets.
Ensure dark mode uses deep charcoal (#141311) and warm parchment tones, NOT harsh dark blue or inverted white.
Implement the Collapsible Editorial Filter Bar with clean horizontal pills and smooth drawer expansion.
Preserve all existing routes, data fetching, B2B wholesale logic, cart, wishlist, auth, checkout, search, and responsive breakpoints from 320px up to 1920px+.
Add data-testid to every interactive component and key data point.
